# Support

MGM Atlas is the lab's internal project HQ. This is where to go for help:

| Need | Where |
|---|---|
| 🐛 Report a bug in the app or API | [Open a bug report](https://github.com/shirasakaren/rement/issues/new/choose) |
| 💡 Ask a question or propose an idea | [Discussions](https://github.com/shirasakaren/rement/discussions) |
| 📊 Check whether Atlas is up | [atlas.labmgm.org/health](https://atlas.labmgm.org/health) (web) · [api/v1/health](https://atlas.labmgm.org/api/v1/health) (API) |
| 📖 Learn how to use the app | [README — user guide](../README.md#-using-atlas) |
| 🔐 Report a security issue | [Security policy](SECURITY.md) — private disclosure only |
